item.title: Twilio Lists 22 A2P 10DLC Rejection Codes for December 9
item.description: Twilio plans to introduce more specific A2P 10DLC campaign rejection codes on December 9, 2026. The 22 codes it lists, in three groups, and what to check now.

item.title: Google Search Referrer Values: Two Patterns to Match
item.description: Google's new Search page, added Nov 12, lists the Referer values Search sends: google.com or a local Google domain, and one Android app string. How to match.
